BiblicalUsage: Omeq means depth. It occurs once, in Proverbs 25:3, where the heaven for height and the earth for depth cannot be searched, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the depth of the earth and the heart of a king are both beyond measuring, and only God searches either one.
